title: Call from a metallic alien voice
summary: Greg Malatzi tells of Call from a metallic alien voice, about 1970s at unspecified, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.difference: Names Sarfatti as the one who got the call, dates it to the 1950s rather than the 1970s, frames the caller as from the future, and says the voice told him he would meet the others and work on building UFOs.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of a phone call from a strange voice, presumably alien or from the future, which matches Sarfatti's well-known childhood call. The match is uncertain because the stored telling does not name who got the call.

plain: A researcher named Greg Malatzi, speaking on Jesse Michels' podcast in an episode about a CIA scientist, tells of a man who got a phone call from a metallic voice. Malatzi says the voice was some kind of alien intelligence, and he places it in the 1970s. On the same episode Michels, the host, retells it his own way. He names the man who got the call as Jack Sarfatti and places it in the 1950s. He says the caller spoke from the future and told Sarfatti he would meet "the others" and would end up working on something like building UFOs. Michels draws on a book by David Kaiser called The Hippies Saved Physics, and he mentions names such as Hal Puthoff and Hans Bethe. The story matters to them because, if true, a non-human intelligence was steering particular people toward secret technology work.
